title: Tumanbay
subtitle: Imperial power, rebellion, and survival in a city built on political danger.
description: A vast empire threatened by rebellion. A fiction podcast on an epic scale set in the most powerful city on earth... Visit www.tumanbay.com to see full credits and download scripts. Can't get enough of the Tumanbay universe? The first Tumanbay novel, "The City of a Thousand Faces" by Walker Dryden, is now available.

archiveTake: A strong recommendation when you want scale, political pressure, and a world that feels bigger than any single character.
